# Lessonspace

Lessonspace is an online collaborative classroom platform that enables educators and students to engage in interactive learning sessions with features like video conferencing, whiteboards, and resource sharing.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/lessonspace/.

## Actions

- **Create Demo Space**: Create a transient demo space for embedding in an iframe.
- **Get Organisation Details** (read-only): Retrieve organisation details, including id, plan, and usage stats.
- **Get Organisation Session List** (read-only): List sessions of an organisation.
- **Launch Space**: Launch a lessonspace space.
